items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the last time we saw you perform live was at the IAJE when you had Sherman Ferguson

ctx.x: Philly Joe, Papa Jo - you name it - Shelly Manne, you name it.
So what is it, when you, the last time we saw you perform live was at the IAJE when you had Sherman Ferguson, rest in peace…

My man, yeah. Brown:…so, I mean, the breadth of the different styles you seem to be able to, not only function, but to create some sort of synergistic effect. I mean, watching you with Sherman was a real treat.
